const day = (offset) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`; };

item.name: RCT-009 ADMIN has read and write on receipt templates, and every role lists the route

exec: pm.expect((b || []).some(y => ((y !== null && typeof y === 'object' && !Array.isArray(y)) && (y?.name === "ADMIN") && ((Array.isArray(y?.routes) && y?.routes.some(y1 => ((y1 !== null && typeof y1 === 'object' && !Array.isArray(y1)) && (y1?.path === "/api/receipt-templates/**") && (y1?.read === true) && (y1?.write === true))))))), " includes {\"name\": \"ADMIN\", \"routes\": {\"$has\": [{\"path\": \"/api/receipt-templates/**\", \"read\": true, \"write\": true}]}}").to.be.true;
